parts.name: band shell

physics.Basic_description: Curved grey plastic arch forming the main structural frame of the headband.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the spring force to clamp the headphones onto the user's head and supports the ear cups.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the top center of the arch with a parallel jaw gripper from above.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic shell enclosing air and potentially wiring; treating as solid would overestimate mass.

parts.description: Curved grey plastic arch forming the main structural frame of the headband.
parts.function: Provides the spring force to clamp the headphones onto the user's head and supports the ear cups.

parts.name: band pad

physics.Basic_description: Black padded strip attached to the underside of the headband arch.
physics.Functional_description: Distributes pressure on the top of the head for comfort during wear.
physics.Grasped_description: Soft and compliant; gripping here would compress the foam without securing the object well.
physics.reason: Foam padding is effectively a solid porous material block for manipulation purposes.

parts.description: Black padded strip attached to the underside of the headband arch.

parts.name: housing l

physics.Basic_description: Small grey plastic component at the left end of the headband arch.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the mechanism for the adjustable slider extension.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and close to the joint to be a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: Small molded plastic cover part.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
